text.p: These are the leading stories in the Moroccan press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- King Hassan congratulates U.S. President Clinton on re-election, says Clinton's determination will ensure that reason prevails and commitments are respected in Middle East.
- Morocco signs convention with Spanish group Gouvarri Industrial S.A. on setting up plant to produce vehicle spares.
- King Hassan tells Interior Minister Driss Basri to take "urgent and effective" measures to have cities cleaned up, as signs of negligence "threaten the health of citizens".
- "Door remains open" for talks with Polisario on disputed Western Sahara, says King Hassan.
- Moroccan envoy to U.N. calls on Security Council to assume its responsibilities and impose its peace plan to resolve dispute in Western Sahara.
- Hundreds of tonnes of Moroccan fruit and vegetables blocked in southern France because of railway workers' strike.
- Low profile for Cairo third economic conference which, after Casablanca and Amman, threatens to be disappointing.
